name: Side Plank Pose
description: Balance on one hand and the edge of the foot with the body in one line.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Start in a high plank: hands under your shoulders, body in one line.
Shift your weight onto one hand and roll onto the outer edge of that foot.

keyframes.name: Plank
keyframes.cue: Hands under shoulders, body in one straight line.

keyframes.name: Side Plank
keyframes.cue: Roll onto the left hand, stack the feet, and lift the right arm.

cues: Lower the bottom knee for support.
